note: Public history of every ARXOS kernel. Text only: the patch code and config stay private. Binaries live on Cloudflare R2 (current, fast) and archive.org / GitHub Releases (full history, rollback).

tunes.name: Live kernel patching
tunes.advantage: Security and stability fixes can be applied to the running kernel without a reboot, so the machine stays up to date without downtime.

tunes.name: Kernel-level anonymity primitives
tunes.advantage: The building blocks the ARXOS privacy tools rely on are compiled in: modern packet filtering, WireGuard, network and user isolation, and encrypted key storage. AnonKit and friends work at the kernel level, not bolted on top.

tunes.name: Low-level device access
tunes.advantage: Fast, direct device input and output is enabled for the ARXOS device toolkit, including raw USB access and a high-performance I/O path. This is what lets droidB talk to hardware quickly and reliably.

tunes.name: Performance base
tunes.advantage: ARXOS keeps the tuned CachyOS performance profile: a responsive desktop scheduler, faster network throughput, a high timer rate, full preemption for low latency, a modern CPU baseline, and better memory behaviour under load. The result is a system that feels quick and stays quick.

kernels.changes: Rebased onto the newer upstream (Linux 7.2.0 via CachyOS). Carries the full ARXOS tune set unchanged: live patching, kernel-level anonymity primitives, low-level device access, and the tuned performance base.
First CachyOS-based ARXOS kernel line. Established the ARXOS tune set over the stock CachyOS base. Superseded by 7.2.0-1.
